# CV Screener

> A local-first MCP server for résumé screening: a synthetic CV dataset, hybrid search that combines
> exact metadata filters with semantic ranking over ChromaDB using local `bge-small` embeddings, and
> interactive widgets rendered inside the chat. It runs on the user's machine over stdio, needs no
> LLM API key, and uploads nothing.

## Install

- [Installation runbook](install.md): step-by-step instructions for an AI agent — prerequisite check, the exact Claude Code command, the exact Claude Desktop JSON and config path per OS, verification and safety rules.

Claude Code, one command:

```
claude mcp add cv-screener -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/ananasDDA/cv-screener cv mcp
```

Claude Desktop, merged into `mcpServers` in `claude_desktop_config.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "cv-screener": {
      "command": "uvx",
      "args": ["--from", "git+https://github.com/ananasDDA/cv-screener", "cv", "mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Requires [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/); uv fetches Python 3.12 itself. The first start takes
30–60 seconds and downloads a ~130 MB embedding model once.

## Tools

- `search_candidates`: hybrid search — `query` ranks by meaning, filters (languages, skills, seniority, role family, country, minimum years) are exact and combine with AND.
- `find_by_name`: full or partial name lookup, tolerant to misspellings.
- `get_candidate`: one full profile by id.
- `list_candidates`: browse the whole collection.
- `add_candidate`: add a résumé the user shared; stored locally in `~/.cv-screener/candidates`.
- `remove_candidate`: remove a résumé the user added earlier.
